slides.source: Survival: American Cancer Society (SEER), diagnosed 2015 to 2021. Guidelines: USPSTF 2024 (every 2 years); American College of Radiology (yearly).

slides.title: 4 tips for a more comfortable mammogram
items: Still getting periods? Book 1 to 2 weeks after, when breasts are less tender.
Skip deodorant, powder and lotion that day.
Bring past mammograms, or tell us where you had them.
